title: The weight of a rectifiable varifold is concentrated on its support (Simon 4.5, proof step (1a))
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U an arbitrary subset of R^{n+l} = EuclideanSpace R (Fin (n+l)), and V a contract rectifiable n-varifold in U (structure RectifiableVarifold n l U). V has carrier M, so M ⊆ U and M is H^n-null-measurable (H^n = μHE[n]), and multiplicity θ. Its weight is μ = V.weight = (H^n restricted to M) with density x ↦ ofReal(θ(x)), and its support is spt V = V.support = U ∩ supp μ, where supp μ = μ.support is the support of the measure μ. Then μ-almost every point of R^{n+l} lies in spt V, i.e. μ(R^{n+l} \ spt V) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ V.support
